coverage_report.temporal_category_note: No hidden_facts in the profile carry category == 'temporal'; all are tagged 'direct' or 'reprojected'. The temporal_hidden_facts_list here is the set of HFs that nonetheless contain an explicit before/after shift in their claim text (e.g., dose increased, height decline, routine established post-widowhood, pace slowed). Rule 2 is satisfied vacuously for the strict tag-based reading and substantively by the Type 3 coverage set.
